plan.goal: Exhaustively explore and critique the Solstice Bank application flow, focusing on the 8-step single-page form, form validation, modals, and responsive layout.
plan.summary: The run will begin on the landing page to evaluate layout and navigation targets before initiating the account application. It will then methodically step through the 8-stage single-page onboarding flow, testing form validation, modals (liveness, funding), and contextual help. Finally, it will test recovery paths (save for later, edit) before submitting to verify the confirmation page, followed by a mobile responsiveness check.
assumptions: The 8-step application flow is entirely contained within apply.html using JavaScript to manage visibility.
Form validation will prevent progression to the next step if mandatory fields are missing or invalid.
Modals (dialogs) are used for complex interactions like liveness checks and bank linking within the flow.
risk_hotspots: Single-page state management across 8 steps in apply.html
Liveness check and Bank connection modals trapping focus or breaking flow
Form validation feedback visibility and clarity
Contextual Help drawer overlapping form content, especially on mobile
Small tap targets identified on index.html navigation links

phases.title: Landing Page & Entry
phases.objective: Verify landing page layout, inspect reported small tap targets, and initiate the application flow.
key_checks: Check navigation links in the header for size and usability
Click 'Open an account' or 'Start application' to transition to apply.html
exit_criteria: apply.html is loaded and Step 1 (Eligibility) is visible

phases.title: Application Flow: Steps 1-4
phases.objective: Navigate the first half of the form, testing basic inputs and validation.
key_checks: Trigger a validation error by attempting to continue without checking mandatory eligibility boxes
Complete Eligibility, About you, Contact & address, and Employment & income steps
Open and close the floating 'Open help' drawer to ensure context updates and doesn't block UI

phases.title: Application Flow: Steps 5-7 & Modals
phases.objective: Interact with complex form elements including file mockups and modals.
key_checks: Interact with ID verification and trigger the Liveness check modal
Complete the Risk questionnaire and observe any soft warnings based on inputs
Interact with the Funding step, specifically the 'Connect your bank' modal
exit_criteria: Successfully closed modals and reached Step 8 (Review)

phases.title: Review, Edge Cases & Submission
phases.objective: Test editing previous steps, saving progress, and final submission.
key_checks: Use an 'Edit' button or the progress tracker to jump back to a previous step, then return to review
Click 'Save & continue later' to observe the interaction/feedback
Submit the final application to reach the confirmation page
exit_criteria: confirmation.html is loaded and the dynamic reference number is visible

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Verify the responsiveness of key components on a mobile screen.
key_checks: Check landing page navigation menu and CTA layout on mobile
Verify form field usability and Help drawer positioning in apply.html on mobile
exit_criteria: Mobile checks completed for primary navigation and form layout

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 3 HTML pages (index, apply, confirmation).
coverage_targets.features: Exercise all 8 steps of the application form, trigger at least two modals, test form validation, and use the help drawer.
coverage_targets.mobile: Switch to mobile viewport to re-test the landing page header and at least one step of the application form.

notes: Pay special attention to the 'small_tap_target' warnings on the landing page, noting if they are critically hard to use.
The application form is a single-page app style, so watch out for DOM changes without page loads.
